div.div: 1 وَطَثَ , (aor. يَطِثُ, K,) inf. n. وَطْثُ, He struck the ground vehemently with his foot: (S, K:) or he (a camel) struck vehemently with his foot: (TA:) a dial. form of وَطَسَ, or viciously pronounced for the latter word: (S:) or the ث of وطث is a substitute for the س of وطس; and the meaning is he broke: (Yaakoob:) or وَطَثَهُ, aor. يَطِثُهُ, inf. n. وَطْثٌ, signifies he trod, or trampled, upon it so that he broke it. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
